about.tagline.en: Send Markdown. Get native Telegram rich text.

home.body.en: Send me Markdown. I’ll render it.

home.group.en: {bot} renders Markdown in a direct message. Open it there and paste your source.

how.body.en: Headings, nested styles, lists, task lists, tables, quotes, code blocks, details, links and formulas.

how.engine.en: {bot} parses nothing itself — your source goes to Telegram and Telegram renders it.

how.hint.en: Paste Markdown here and Telegram renders it

how.split.en: A paste your client splits into several messages is stitched back together first.

msg.render_failed.en: I couldn’t render that Markdown. Check the syntax and try again.
